_README: android-managed-config-ariba.json — SAP Ariba Android managed configuration (PLACEHOLDER example).
*** PLACEHOLDER KEYS — VERIFY AGAINST SAP ARIBA DOCUMENTATION ***
SAP states the SAP Ariba Procurement mobile app is NOT certified with MDM on Android as of
current documentation. This file shows the GENERAL Android managed-configuration pattern with
Ariba-style placeholder keys so the worked example is complete across platforms — it is NOT a
confirmed Ariba Android schema. If/when SAP supports Android MDM, take the exact keys from the
app's managed-configuration schema (Intune Configuration designer) and the SAP Ariba Procurement
On Android, prefer the Configuration designer (schema-driven) over raw JSON.
HOSTNAME, NOT URL: server_host is a bare hostname (e.g. s1.ariba.com) — no https://, no path.
realm = the buyer subdomain (realm= value from your Ariba SSO/ACS URL).
